title: Prove a shared-frame normalization gate for QQ16 template lifts
body:
The fixed104-owner-route repair of PR4003's ordered QQ16 residual cannot save its104 native normalizations by changing one shared input-query frame. This PR proves that gate for every positive integer λ, including common frames that mix planes, under the explicitly separately normalized branch contract and prescribed phase-normalizer tariff. For `0≤a≤10/13`, the minimum formal native moment is the unchanged `104 λ^(1-a)`; every nonzero common polar perturbation is strictly worse.

The source certificate partitions the104 pulled-back defect directions into12 independent groups, the minimum possible given their rank9 span. This gives the all-parameter inequality `Σ rank(defect) ≥104λ+80 rank(Δ)`. Symmetric image intersections and concavity prove the result; no lifted-frame census is used. The bounded seed47 balanced-greedy construction found the exact partition on its first restart. For λ=1 and `0≤a≤1/2`, the stronger nonzero-change lower bound is >144 versus baseline104.

The104 source owner routes and the F16 output frame are fixed. A different owner decomposition, shared/joint branch normalization, changed producer/output frame, paid address-valued scans or other alphabets remain outside scope. The tariff is an accounting model, not a wall-clock or bit/tape lower bound. Retention, routing, helpers, restoration, precision and actual outer consumption are still separate nonnegative obligations, granted free only in the favorable lower-bound screen. No new κ, physical supplier admission or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

Validation: registered Python3.12 replay of all four commands; exact full Z4 source frames and owners; a separate no-inherited-code row/character implementation; 15,834 small rank-one cases; 4,164 symmetric-pair guards; a genuinely plane-mixing λ=2 fixture;16 behavioral rejections. All four registered optimized commands also passed from the official read-only Git-free export; all37 frozen files stayed unchanged. Finite checks accompany the written quantified proof, not formal-kernel acceptance.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-common-query-frame-cost
```

Base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. Runtime inputs are22 authenticated canonical files; no pending executable or network source is imported. Scientific code freeze `c69513d4e62f042000ce6a1a4d505bf71d23d42a`; later changes are scope/receipt prose. Exact source pins, certificates, bounded construction domain and remaining questions are included. Hosted CI is a separate status.

Credit Chris R / Clear1nsight's PR4003 (`309189077d0f760248bbdaadab42ecbff4f3ea2d`) for the exact ordered residual and failed bypass; its prefix/surjection proof is inherited, not rerun here. Preserve ywz65/PR2707, Arham Tahir/PR2681, Ali Romman and the full retained native/compiler/geometry lineage. PR3985 (`400df7fca8f60c19bf163c77564fe3fbe9154b04`) supplies the104-normalizer comparison; PR4015's storage schedule is distinct. New work Tekalign (`tekuuu`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0, no human/formal review claimed.
